intro:
Posting every day takes hours: the hook, the caption, the replies, the plan for next week. Here's how I hand all of that to Claude while keeping it sounding like me.

Five skills, one Project, and you stay in control: Claude drafts, you approve and post.

free.title: Step 1: Make a Claude Project for your Instagram (5 minutes)
free.body:
In Claude, create a Project called "Instagram". In its instructions, paste the brief below. Every skill in this kit reads it, so your posts sound like your business every time.

Copy this inMy business: [what you sell, to whom] My offer and its price: [offer] Who I want to reach: [ideal customer] How I talk: [3 words, e.g. direct, warm, funny] Words I never use: [e.g. game-changer, unlock, elevate] My call to action: [e.g. comment GUIDE, book a call]

free.title: Step 2: The hook writer
free.body:
The first line decides whether anyone watches. Ask for hooks in proven shapes, then pick one.

Copy this inWrite 10 hooks for a post about [topic]. Use these shapes, two each: 1) "I asked AI to ___" 2) a number and a promise ("3 ways to ___") 3) a mistake ("Stop ___") 4) a before/after 5) a bold claim I can back up. Under 12 words each. No emojis, no hype words.

free.title: Step 3: The caption writer
free.body: Copy this inWrite the caption for this post: [what the video shows]. Start with the hook I picked: [hook]. Then 3 short lines of value a business owner can use today. End with my call to action. Under 120 words, sounds like me.

free.title: Step 4: Comment replies, drafted for you to approve
free.body:
Copy your new comments in (or a screenshot), and let Claude draft the replies. You read, tweak and post them yourself.

Copy this inHere are the comments on my latest post: [paste]. Draft a reply to each: friendly, specific to what they said, under 25 words. If someone asks about price or working together, invite them to DM me. Flag any comment I should answer personally.

free.title: Step 5: The weekly plan
free.body: Copy this inPlan my next 7 posts. Mix: 3 teach (a how-to), 2 proof (a result or story), 1 behind the scenes, 1 offer. For each: the topic, the hook, the format (reel, carousel or photo) and the call to action. Base it on what my customers ask me most: [3 common questions].

free.title: Step 6: The human check
free.body:
Run everything through this before you post. It catches the phrases that make writing sound like AI.

Copy this inCheck this text for AI-sounding writing: [paste]. Score it 0-100 for how human it sounds. List every phrase that gives it away ("in today's fast-paced world", "unlock", "dive in", em dashes everywhere, three-item lists in every line) and rewrite it the way I'd actually say it.

Turn each step into a reusable Claude skill: save the prompt as a skill in the Project so you can run it with one line next time.
